scenes.say: Do you need a tax audit this year?
scenes.title: Tax audit: who needs it?

scenes.say: For business, audit applies when turnover is above ₹1 crore.
scenes.title: Business: above ₹1 crore
scenes.sub: Limit is ₹10 crore if cash receipts and payments are each 5% or less.

scenes.say: For professionals, the limit is ₹50 lakh of gross receipts.
scenes.title: Professionals: above ₹50 lakh
scenes.sub: Doctors, lawyers, CAs, engineers, architects and others.

scenes.say: Under the presumptive scheme, declare the set profit and skip the audit.
scenes.title: Presumptive scheme
scenes.sub: Sections 44AD and 44ADA. Declaring less profit can bring an audit.

scenes.say: The audit report date is extended to 21 October 2026.
scenes.title: Due date: 21 Oct 2026
scenes.sub: Return for audited cases: 21 Nov 2026 (CBDT Circular 07/2026).

scenes.say: Check your turnover and keep your books ready.
scenes.title: Check turnover, not profit
scenes.sub: General guide only. Other conditions apply.
